headline: 《奥德赛》领跑今日热搜，《蜘蛛侠》新作受瞩目
headlineEn: Odyssey Leads Today's Hot Search, New Spider-Man Draws Attention
summary: 今日院线零新片，本周仅两部新片上映。热搜由《奥德赛》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领衔，《别祝我好运》《侠探杰克》《复仇者联盟5：毁灭之日》紧随其后，市场静待新片表现。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today, with only two opening this week. Hot searches are led by Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day, followed by Don't Wish Me Luck, Reacher, and Avengers: Doomsday, as the market awaits new releases.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共2部新片。
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today; only 2 films open this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》登顶本周热搜榜。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops the weekly trending list.

industryHighlights.text: 《奥德赛》成为今日最热话题影片。
industryHighlights.en: Odyssey is the hottest film topic today.

industryHighlights.text: 暂无重磅新片定档，市场热度集中于既有话题大片。
industryHighlights.en: No major upcoming titles announced; buzz centers on existing tentpole films.
